title: Bhutan Thimphu Tshechu Festival Tour | Monasteries, Valleys & Mountains
highlights: This thoughtfully curated Bhutan holiday combines sacred monasteries and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes with the Thimphu Tshechu Festival, (21st–23rd September 2026).
Stay in comfortable hotels across Phuentsholing, Thimphu, Punakha, and Paro at an excellent price, offering a relaxing base throughout your Bhutan adventure.
Explore Bhutan's most iconic attractions, including Tiger's Nest Monastery, Punakha Dzong, Phobjikha Valley, Buddha Dordenma, Dochula Pass, and Chele La Pass.
Witness the spectacular Thimphu Tshechu Festival, where centuries-old masked cham dances, colourful costumes, and sacred rituals showcase Bhutan's living cultural heritage.
Enjoy a hassle-free journey with all major transfers, well-planned sightseeing, and a professionally coordinated group tour for a smooth travel experience.
overview:
About the Tour:
Experience the magic of Bhutan on an unforgettable journey through its serene valleys, sacred monasteries, vibrant festivals, and breathtaking Himalayan landscapes. Begin in the peaceful border town of Phuentsholing before travelling to Thimphhu, where you'll explore iconic landmarks and witness the spectacular Thimphu Tshechu Festival, featuring sacred masked dances and centuries-old traditions. Cross the scenic Dochula Pass to discover Punakha's magnificent dzong, suspension bridge, and the picturesque Phobjikha Valley, home to the endangered black-necked cranes. Continue to Paro and embark on the legendary hike to the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery, dramatically perched on a cliffside. Complete your adventure with a scenic drive over Chele La Pass, Bhutan's highest motorable pass, offering panoramic Himalayan views. Blending cultural heritage, spiritual experiences, scenic mountain drives, and authentic Bhutanese hospitality, this journey offers the perfect introduction to the Land of the Thunder Dragon.

know_before_you_go: Entry permits are processed at Phuentsholing Immigration Office. Guests must carry valid government-issued ID (Voter ID or Passport) and 2 passport-size photographs. The guide will assist with the process.
SDF of ₹1,200 per person per night is mandatory and is included the package.
All transfers in Bhutan are on a sharing basis. India-side transfers will be by Innova/Swift/WagonR, depending on group size.
Daily breakfast & dinner are included along with one complimentary lunch at Le Meridien Riverfront in  Paro.
Sightseeing is point-to-point as per itinerary only. Any extra sightseeing or detours not mentioned will be chargeable.
The hike takes around 4–6 hours (round trip) and involves steep walking. A basic fitness level is required. Ponies or personal assistance, if needed, are payable directly.
One basic hot stone bath in Paro is included after the Tiger’s Nest hike. Advanced or private setups may involve extra cost.
A professional English-speaking BTC-certified guide will accompany the group. Also, one tourist SIM card will be provided per group/booking on arrival.
Weather in Bhutan can be cold in mornings and evenings, especially in higher regions. Thus, carry warm clothing.
Indian Rupees are widely accepted (₹100 notes recommended). ATMs are limited; keep sufficient cash for lunches, entry tickets, and personal expenses.
Group tours run on fixed timings. Guests are requested to be on time for departures to avoid delays for others.
Hotels follow standard check-in/check-out timings. Early check-in or late check-out is subject to availability.
Bhutan is a peaceful country. Loud music, disturbances, or inappropriate behaviour inside hotels or public areas is discouraged.
Dress modestly while visiting monasteries and dzongs. Shoes must be removed where required. Photography may be restricted in certain areas.
Follow the guide’s instructions at all times, especially during mountain drives and hikes.
Expenses such as lunches, entry tickets, shopping, tips, optional activities, and personal purchases are not included unless specified.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bagdogra | Transfer to Phuentsholing | Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arriving at Bagdogra Airport/New Jalpaiguri Railway Station, board your transfer and enjoy a scenic drive to Phuentsholing, the charming gateway to Bhutan. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax for the day. Later, you can visit the beautiful Zangto Pelri Lhakhang, admired for its beautiful murals and peaceful ambience, or take a leisurely stroll through Phuentsholing Market to experience the local culture and browse for handicrafts and souvenirs.

days.title: Phuentsholing to Thimphu | Evening Free Time to Explore
days.desc: Check-out from your hotel and complete the immigration formalities before beginning your scenic drive to Thimphu, Bhutan's capital. En route, stop at the Chukha Hydropower Project Viewpoint, one of the country's pioneering renewable energy projects, & admire the surrounding mountain landscapes. Upon arrival in Thimphu, check in to your hotel & relax. Later, you can explore the lively Clock Tower Square, browse local handicraft markets or savour Bhutanese specialties such as Ema Datshi.

days.title: Thimphu City Sightseeing with Thimphu Tshechu Festival | Thimphu to Punakha via Dochula Pass
days.desc: Check out and visit Kuenselphodrang, home to the towering Buddha Dordenma. Also, explore Tashichho Dzong, where you can visit Thimphu Tshechu Festival, one of Bhutan's grandest cultural celebrations, where monks and performers present sacred masked cham dances in colourful traditional costumes. Then, visit the Motithang Takin Preserve, where you can see Bhutan's unique national animal. Afterwards, drive to Punakha via the scenic Dochula Pass. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel.

items.title: Thimphu Sightseeing Tour - Full-Day Sightseeing Tour

days.title: Punakha | Visit to Wangdue Phodrang Dzong & Phobjikha Valley Excursion
days.desc: Begin your day with a visit to the historic Wangdue Phodrang Dzong, one of Bhutan's oldest and most significant fortresses, overlooking the confluence of two rivers. Continue with a scenic drive to the Phobjikha Valley, a glacial valley celebrated for its landscapes and rich biodiversity. Visit the 17th-century Gangtey Monastery & visit the Black-Necked Crane Information Centre, where you can learn about the conservation of migratory birds and, during winter, spot them in their natural habitat.

items.title: Excursion to Phobjika Valley from Punakha

days.title: Phunakha Sightseeing Tour | Punakha to Paro
days.desc: Check-out & set out to explore the cultural treasures of Punakha. Visit the Punakha Dzong, Bhutan's most beautiful fortress, located at the confluence of the Pho Chu & Mo Chu rivers. Next, walk across the iconic Punakha Suspension Bridge, one of the country's longest suspension bridges, offering views of the valley & river below. Continue to Chimi Lhakhang, the Temple of Fertility, dedicated to the Divine Madman, Lama Drukpa Kunley. Later, enjoy a scenic drive to Paro & check in to your hotel.

days.title: Paro | Tiger’s Nest Hike & Free Time
days.desc: Begin your day with a drive to Satsam Chorten, the starting point of the iconic Tiger's Nest Monastery (Paro Taktsang) trek. Hike through fragrant pine forests adorned with colourful prayer flags while soaking in stunning views of the Paro Valley. Upon reaching the monastery, explore its sacred temples, ancient murals, and meditation caves, where Guru Padmasambhava is believed to have meditated in the 8th century. After descending, return to Paro and spend the rest of the day at leisure.

days.title: Paro to Phuntsholing via Chelela Pass | Free Time
days.desc: Today, check out from your hotel & set out for a scenic excursion to Chele La Pass, the highest motorable pass in Bhutan. As you ascend through dense forests of pine & rhododendron, enjoy mountain views, with the Mount Jomolhari visible on clear days. Spend some time at the pass admiring the colourful prayer flags fluttering in the mountain breeze, soaking in Himalayan views, or taking a short walk along the ridgeline. Later, continue your drive to Phuentsholing & check in to your hotel.

days.title: Phuentsholing to Bagdogra | Departure
days.desc: After checking out from your hotel, board your transfer to Bagdogra Airport or New Jalpaiguri Railway Station for your onward journey. As you travel through the scenic Himalayan foothills, cherish the unforgettable memories of Bhutan's ancient monasteries, picturesque valleys, vibrant festivals, and breathtaking mountain passes. Your memorable journey through the Land of the Thunder Dragon comes to an end.
